text:
incident-bot: [P1] SmartRouting alert — spike in 5xxs and request latency for toolcall-enabled chat in eu-west. Automated fallback to quantized variants detected, which lack tool-calling hooks and are triggering repeated reroutes -> oscillation. Paging oncall now.

sara-olsen: on it. I see the alert graph, latency jumped ~600ms p95 and 502s increasing ~3x. Any immediate customer hits?

mike-sharma: seeing the same in metrics. Route smart-route-chat-toolcall-eu is toggling between redwood-v2-fp16 and redwood-v2-quant-8bit. quantized variant does not have tool-call tokenization integration, so calls return structured-toolcall:error and routing thinks variant failed -> fallback to other region -> loop.

anya-oncall: tagging product and runtime. @oliver-p do we have compat matrix entry for redwood-v2-quant-8bit showing toolcall support? I can't find it.

oliver-p: quick check — matrix incorrectly marked redwood-v2-quant-8bit as toolcall-compatible due to an earlier import bug. We shipped that wrong flag in the model catalog last week. Not all quant variants implemented toolcall glue.

sara-olsen: ok that explains it. Plan: 1) stop cross-region fallback for this route, 2) pin route to the known-good fp16 variant in eu-west, 3) hotpatch compat matrix entry to remove toolcall flag for quantized variants, 4) follow-up rollout for corrected variants. I'll take 1+2.

mike-sharma: agree. I'll run the admin pin.

mike-sharma: runbook command I'm using:
```
# pin route to fp16 in eu-west
adminctl pin-route --route "chat-toolcall" --region "eu-west" --model "redwood-v2-fp16" --reason "emergency: quant variant lacks toolcall support"
```

sara-olsen: I'm disabling cross-region fallback on the route now (will enable circuit breaker).
```
# turn off region fallback for this route
adminctl update-route --route "chat-toolcall" --set "fallback_policy=none,cb_enabled=true"
```

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: compat-matrix-hotfix (PR #3421) by oliver-p -> staging. CI ok.

oliver-p: pushed the hotfix to the model catalog: removed "toolcall": true flag from all quantized variants and added a validation check. Will request rollout to prod after we stabilize.

anya-oncall: customer impact note: preliminary query of request logs shows ~4 customers with heavy traffic hitting toolcall chat endpoints (org ids: org-113, org-201, org-777, org-309). Most errors are transient 502/structured-toolcall:error. ETA to reduce customer-facing errors after pin/disable is ~3-6 minutes post-change.

sara-olsen: change 1 (disable fallback) applied @ 1769994385. Verified route no longer cross-region routing in logs.

mike-sharma: pin applied @ 1769994393. Metrics starting to settle. p50/p95 dropping, retries reducing.

anya-oncall: confirming customers: org-113 reported increased errors starting ~1769994300. I'll open a customer-facing status update and mark as "degraded" with note about toolcall errors; will notify CSMs.

oliver-p: after we stabilize, we need a postmortem: root cause = bad metadata ingestion for model catalog that set toolcall flag on quantized variants. Secondary cause = routing policy allowed cross-region fallback without variant capability checks. Fixes: catalog validation + routing policy gate (deny fallback to variants missing required features) + add automated smoke test for toolcalling on variant rollouts.

mike-sharma: quick telemetry snippet that helped identify pattern:
```
# sample logs
[1769994371] route=chat-toolcall region=eu-west -> model=redwood-v2-quant-8bit response=structured-toolcall:error code=501
[1769994371] router: fallback -> region=eu-central
[1769994372] region=eu-central -> model=redwood-v2-fp16 ok
[1769994373] router: fallback back -> eu-west -> picks quant-8bit -> error -> loop
```

deploy-bot: Hotfix rollout to prod for compat-matrix completed at 1769994460.

sara-olsen: monitoring shows steady state. p95 down to pre-incident within 8 minutes of pin.

anya-oncall: updated incident severity to P2 at 1769994480 due to mitigations. Customer-facing update posted.

oliver-p: action items:
- short term: add gating to router so fallback only goes to variants with explicit feature matches (toolcall, context-length).
- medium term: extend model catalog ingestion testing to run a small toolcall smoke test when marking variants as toolcall-compatible.
- long term: add route-level policy to prefer feature-validated variants and add circuit-breaker thresholds that stop region fallback oscillations.

sara-olsen: I'm handing off to morning oncall @ 1769994550. @anya-oncall will monitor overnight and coordinate any customer escalations.

anya-oncall: ack, I'll own post-incident notes and follow up on customer remediation timeline.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged and routed to oncall: sara-olsen.

sara-olsen: draft postmortem notes prepared; will upload to incidents/ postmortems and link to the logs. Closing this thread once postmortem is published. :white_check_mark:

mike-sharma: final note — temp mitigation: if anyone sees residue oscillation, run `adminctl throttle-route --route "chat-toolcall" --limit 50/s` to buy time.

---
Summary timeline (for postmortem):
- 1769994310: incident-bot paged oncall for smart-routing failures
- 1769994371: errors show quantized variant returning structured-toolcall:error
- 1769994385: disabled cross-region fallback on route (sara-olsen)
- 1769994393: pinned route to fp16 variant (mike-sharma)
- 1769994460: compat-matrix hotfix deployed (oliver-p)
- 1769994480: severity reduced to P2
- 1769994550: oncall handoff to anya-oncall

Impact: transient elevated 5xxs and latency for toolcall chat in eu-west affecting ~4 customers; mitigated within ~20 minutes.

Post-incident owners: oliver-p (catalog fix + automation), mike-sharma (router gating + CBs), sara-olsen (runbook updates + oncall playbook).
